title: Container image CVE scan (Trivy)
summary: Scheduled/manual Trivy scan of container images (base-image OS CVEs + secrets) listed in .trivy-images.txt.
notes: Scans container IMAGES for OS-package CVEs + secrets with `trivy image` — complementary to `agentsec audit`, whose TrivyRunner does `trivy fs` (dependency/IaC scanning) but not base-image OS CVEs. List the images to scan, one ref per line, in the shipped `.trivy-images.txt` (no images are embedded). The Trivy binary is version- + sha256-pinned; bump both together from the Trivy releases page. Public images only by default; for private registries add a docker-login step with registry credentials as secrets.
